spatial_computation.reason: No confirmed TR/radar coordinates or registered geometries recovered. Computing distance from the dataset event envelope or assigning its center to sensors would create false precision.

decision: Retain AD1 as geometry/general method reference. Thermal study and its cited radar investigation form a promising named-site chain, but exact AD1-polygon co-location remains unproved. No same-polygon thermal/GPR claim.
